summary.intent: Investigate and fix an IPNS routing failure with someguy locally by adding a properly configured someguy service to the local docker-compose.
summary.outcome: Added a corrected someguy service to docker-compose.yml with proper libp2p port exposure, accelerated DHT mode, and relaxed resource limits, then committed and pushed for deployment.

repo: cipher-box uses delegated routing via someguy for IPNS resolution, configured in apps/api/src/ipns/delegated-routing.client.ts
The project has separate docker-compose files for local and staging environments: docker/docker-compose.yml and docker/docker-compose.staging.yml

code.finding: someguy service was missing libp2p port 4004 exposure, used 'standard' DHT mode instead of 'accelerated', had too-tight resources (0.5 CPU, 768MB RAM, 512MB libp2p), and low connection limits (50/300 vs defaults 100/3000) — all contributing to IPNS routing failure

workflow: Previous someguy deployment issues were discoverable via git history research on Phase 19 work
someguy Resource Manager errors are triggered by insufficient memory/CPU limits

friction: The prior someguy configuration had multiple compounding misconfigurations (port, DHT mode, resources, connection limits) that were not obvious from a single root cause
open_items: Verify the fix works end-to-end on the Docker host after pulling the updated compose file
